description: Place a text file and flow it across as many pages as it needs in one call — creates the frames, links them, adds pages when it runs out, and reports where the story ended and whether it still overflows

documentIndex.description: Index into the open-document list (see document_getState); defaults to the front document

document_id.description: Which open document to act on: a name (see document_listOpen) or a 0-based index. Defaults to the front document.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the text file to place (.txt, .rtf, .docx, … or a text-only .indd)

maxPages.description: Hard cap on frames created; if reached, the remaining overset text is reported, not thrown

pageIndex.description: Page to start the story on (0-based)

name: recipe_flowTextStory
